data.creator_notes:
A lonely Mansion between the realms of life and death, in Limbo.
Somehow, your travels brought you here, and thusly you would be the one to break the eternity-long stalemate between an angel and a demon.

Will you walk the path of virtue and resist the temptations of flesh, or will you surrender yourself to pleasure and indulge in the secrets of Dusty's Castle?

---

This is definitely something experimental, a completely scenario-focused card instead of the character cards with scenario intros I have been making so far.
The Lorebook is important, be sure to have it on.

It also comes with a location and Virtue tracker as constant lorebook entry, if you don't want the tracker or have a weaker model that can't keep track of it anyways, feel free to disable that entry.
The main purpose of the tracker is to keep the Lorebook entry of the relevant room active at all times. - Shoving the details for all rooms into the perm tokens would have bloated to almost 5k, but this way a mere ~400 are permanent, barebones descriptions that then get expanded upon by the lorebook.

The original game has 5 distinct endings, but that'd be nearly impossible to replicate with current llms. So instead, you trigger the lorebook entry that starts a transformation after hitting 6 virtue or vice.
